info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Create Consumer Service Bank Draft-spec
info.description: The Consumer Service Bank Draft API facilitates the creation of bank drafts for consumer services. This endpoint allows users to initiate and submit bank draft requests, providing a seamless experience for managing consumer banking operations. Typical consumers of this API include financial institutions and banking applications seeking to automate the bank draft creation process. By leveraging this API, developers can enhance their applications with efficient payment solutions that cater to consumer needs in a secure manner.

post.summary: Create a new bank draft for a consumer.
post.description: This endpoint allows the creation of a bank draft associated with a consumer's account, ensuring that all necessary details are provided for successful processing.
